description: A bullish and a bearish FVG overlap by exactly half the smaller band, and both parents are genuinely still live, so a Balanced Price Range composes over the intersection.
labelling_rationale: SLS §5.6 composes a BPR when a bullish and a bearish FVG intersect by at least 50 percent of the smaller band, both are within P.ict.bpr_pair_age = 30 candles, and both parents are still OPEN or TOUCHED; the BPR band is the intersection and its polarity is that of the LATER parent. The bullish parent registers at candle 2 as [H[0], L[2]] = [100, 106], a gap of 6 against an ATR of 73/14 from eleven filler true ranges of 5 plus the scenario's 2, 11 and 5, clearing the 0.25 x ATR floor of roughly 1.30 several times over. This is the one threshold in the golden suite that is not a round number: the filler height was chosen to keep the BEARISH parent's ATR exact at 5, because its gap of 2 sits much closer to its floor and is the binding constraint. The bearish parent registers at candle 5 as [H[5], L[3]] = [105, 107], a gap of 2 against an ATR of exactly 5 from true ranges 2, 11, 5, 4, 6 and 2 summing to 30 over six candles, clearing the 1.25 floor. Their intersection is [105, 106], a width of 1; the smaller band is the bearish one at height 2, so the ratio is exactly 0.5 and the at-least-50-percent test passes on its boundary. The later parent is the bearish one, so the BPR is BEARISH over [105, 106] at candle 5. The parent-liveness condition is the delicate part and is why this geometry was chosen. A bearish FVG's band sits entirely ABOVE the candle that creates it, so that candle usually drops into any overlapping bullish zone and pushes it past CE. Here candle 5 spans only 104 to 105, staying above the bullish zone's CE of 103, so the bullish parent reaches no further than TOUCHED — which §5.6 still accepts. Its lifecycle is: candle 3 never enters the band, since its low of 107 is above the band top of 106; candle 4 dips to 105, inside the band but above CE, giving OPEN to TOUCHED; candle 5 touches again without reaching CE and TOUCHED is not re-emitted. The bearish parent has no candle after it and stays OPEN. All three zones are non-terminal, so all three are live. Candle numbers above are scenario-relative; the 294 declared filler candles (SLS §1.9 warm-up) shift them by 294 in the expected output. The filler's high matches the scenario's first candle so the seam cannot form a swing high, and its low sits below so it cannot form a swing low; neither a bullish nor a bearish three-candle gap spans the seam, so declared history registers no zone of its own.
